description: This file defines the 'GenericGrainInterfaceType' struct, which represents a parameterized grain interface type in Orleans. It includes methods for parsing, constructing, and retrieving information about generic grain interface types.

classes.name: GenericGrainInterfaceType
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a parameterized grain interface type with methods for parsing, constructing, and retrieving type information.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainInterfaceType into a GenericGrainInterfaceType, returning true if successful.

methods.name: GetGenericGrainType
methods.description: Returns a non-constructed version of this generic grain interface type.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Constructs a generic grain interface type with specified type arguments.

methods.name: GetArguments
methods.description: Retrieves the type arguments used to construct this generic grain interface type.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the grain interface type.
